events.title: Departure from Palos
events.description: Christopher Columbus departs Palos de la Frontera, Spain.

events.title: Canary Islands – La Gomera
events.description: The fleet stops at La Gomera for repairs and provisions.

events.title: Westbound into the Atlantic
events.description: The fleet departs La Gomera and sails west into open ocean.

events.title: Mid-Atlantic crossing
events.description: Weeks at sea with no sight of land.

events.title: Approaching the Bahamas
events.description: Signs of land spotted; birds and floating vegetation appear.

events.title: Landfall at San Salvador
events.description: Land is sighted and Columbus makes landfall in the Bahamas.
